issues.label: Financial misconduct finding on share transfers
issues.why: R.C. 3105.171(E)(4) requires the court to determine whether Mahendra committed financial misconduct warranting a distributive/greater award to Sangita.

issues.label: Dissipation of marital assets
issues.why: The court must decide whether gifting Vora Ventures shares to daughters dissipated Sangita's marital interest requiring compensation.

issues.label: Validity and timing of share transfers
issues.why: Whether the transfers actually occurred before or after separation affects whether they were legitimate estate planning or divorce planning.

issues.label: Sangita's knowledge and consent to transfers
issues.why: Her signatures and disputed awareness bear on whether the transfers were consensual or a unilateral scheme.

issues.label: Court's authority to alter corporate structure
issues.why: Whether the court needed to unwind the operating agreements versus simply equitably compensating Sangita in the property division.

issues.label: Equitable vs. equal division of property
issues.why: R.C. 3105.171 requires an equitable division, potentially unequal, given the alleged misconduct and the parties' contributions.

issues.label: Valuation of AnuPriya vacation home
issues.why: The court must choose between competing expert valuations differing by about $6 million.

issues.label: Valuation of SGV 15% interest
issues.why: Competing expert valuations differ by about $3 million and require resolution.

issues.label: SGV partner debt in valuation
issues.why: Whether the alleged 87 million rupee debt to partners should reduce the SGV valuation.

issues.label: Application of foreign law (Civ.R. 44.1)
issues.why: Mahendra's HUF claims require the court to determine and apply Indian law properly.

issues.label: Whether AnuPriya transferred to MV HUF
issues.why: Court must decide if declarations sufficed to transfer property despite title remaining in Mahendra's name.

issues.label: Whether SGV shares transferred to MV HUF
issues.why: Court relied on Sangita's failure to contradict, raising whether the finding was properly supported.

issues.label: HUF assets remaining marital property
issues.why: Even if transferred to the HUF, whether these assets stay marital and subject to division must be decided.

issues.label: Sangita's status as HUF 'member'
issues.why: As a member without vested interest, her rights in HUF assets under Indian law require analysis.

issues.label: Bank of Baroda account characterization
issues.why: Court made no HUF finding but declared it marital, requiring proper classification.

issues.label: Spousal support determination under R.C. 3105.18
issues.why: The court must properly weigh statutory factors in awarding $10,000 monthly support.

issues.label: Adequacy of spousal support findings
issues.why: Whether the court sufficiently articulated the basis for the support amount given the large asset award.

issues.label: Interest-free payment plan equity
issues.why: Whether allowing seven years interest-free on $18 million is equitable to Sangita.

issues.label: Interest rate on deferred payments
issues.why: Whether 5% after seven years versus statutory or requested 10% is appropriate.

issues.label: Restraint on transferring Vora Ventures
issues.why: Whether the injunction adequately secures Sangita's deferred payments.

issues.label: Currency conversion methodology
issues.why: The disputed rupee-to-dollar conversion formula affects the value of Indian assets awarded.

issues.label: Valuation date of Goldman Sachs accounts
issues.why: The proper valuation date affects the marital estate's value and division.

issues.label: Effect of stipulated Vora Ventures valuation
issues.why: The $96 million stipulation constrains the court's valuation of the marital portion.

issues.label: Credibility determinations among witnesses
issues.why: Conflicting testimony from Mahendra, daughters, and Sangita requires credibility findings supporting the outcome.

issues.label: Contributions of homemaker spouse
issues.why: Sangita's non-economic contributions bear on equitable division of a $100+ million estate.

issues.label: Sufficiency of factual findings generally
issues.why: Court must make findings adequate to support and permit review of its property division decisions.
